name: Stardust Video & Coffee
address: 1842 Winter Park Rd, Orlando, FL 32803, USA
ai_summary: Eclectic hangout with a cafe, bar, used-book shop, photo booth, and frequent live music.
review_summary:
People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, a wide selection of food and drinks, and features live music and events. They also highlight the unique, eclectic, and cozy atmosphere, along with the friendly staff and convenient parking.

Some reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.

name: Haan Coffee
address: 1235 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803, USA
ai_summary: Cozy cafe known for its Korean-inspired, dessert-topped coffee drinks, pastries and other treats.
review_summary: People say this coffee shop offers delicious and unique coffee and matcha drinks, including popular options like the Seoul Iced Coffee and black sesame latte, along with tasty pastries and croffles. Visitors highlight the welcoming atmosphere, which is great for working or socializing, and the friendly, efficient staff. They also mention the reasonable prices and quick service, even when busy.

name: White Wolf Cafe
address: 1829 N Orange Ave, Orlando, FL 32804, USA
ai_summary: Cinnamon buns, pancakes and other brunch fare in a cozy space with eclectic decor.
review_summary: Diners like this cafe's delicious and hearty breakfast and brunch offerings, including the popular crab cake eggs Benedict and colossal cinnamon rolls. They also highlight the eclectic, cozy, and welcoming atmosphere, as well as the friendly and attentive staff.

name: Craft & Common
address: 47 E Robinson St Unit 100, Orlando, FL 32801, USA
ai_summary: Charming caffeine house featuring craft coffee, teas, pastries, bagels and sandwiches, plus beer and wine.
review_summary: People say this coffee shop offers delicious and unique coffee and chai options, along with tasty food like breakfast sandwiches and waffles. Visitors highlight the warm, inviting, and spacious atmosphere, often filled with plants, making it a great spot to relax or work. They also mention the friendly, helpful, and attentive staff who provide excellent service.

name: The Burrow Cafe and Play
address: 618 N Mills Ave, Orlando, FL 32803, USA
ai_summary: Coffeehouse and cafe featuring a playful indoor play space for kids, plus games.
review_summary:
People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, including unique seasonal drinks, and a variety of food options like breakfast burritos and toasts. They also highlight the clean, engaging play area for children, the welcoming atmosphere, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the play area can be expensive.

name: Deeply Coffee Company
address: 111 N Magnolia Ave #50, Orlando, FL 32801, USA
ai_summary: Cozy coffeehouse for specialty brews, plus sandwiches and pastries.
review_summary: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, especially the cold brew and seasonal lattes, and highlight their exceptional matcha drinks, including blueberry and mango varieties. They also mention the friendly and helpful staff, fast service, and a vibrant, cozy atmosphere with good music. Visitors appreciate the spotless environment and the availability of tasty food items like breakfast sandwiches and homemade pop tarts.

name: Stemma Craft Coffee
address: 328 N Orange Ave, Orlando, FL 32801, USA
ai_summary: Casual shop for locally roasted coffee from the owners' Nicaraguan farm and a variety of eats.
review_summary: People say this coffee shop offers delicious, high-quality coffee, including unique craft and seasonal drinks, and a variety of tasty breakfast sandwiches and pastries. They also highlight the warm, inviting atmosphere and the friendly, knowledgeable staff. Guests mention the clean facilities, including restrooms, and appreciate the convenient parking options.

name: Lineage Coffee
address: 1011 E Colonial Dr, Orlando, FL 32803, USA
ai_summary: Vibrant, trendy coffee shop offering espresso drinks, tea, and baked goods.
review_summary: People say this cafe offers excellent coffee, including flavorful pour-overs and smooth lattes, along with delicious freshly baked pastries like croissants. They also highlight the pleasant atmosphere, which is suitable for working or relaxing, and the convenient parking. Guests mention the staff are kind, helpful, and provide great service.

name: Bynx Orlando
address: 420 E Church St #118, Orlando, FL 32801, USA
ai_summary: Coffee shop also selling used vinyl records and collectible books, as well as beer, wine and spirits.
review_summary: People say this cafe offers a wide variety of coffee, matcha, and specialty drinks, along with delicious pastries and food items like breakfast wraps and charcuterie. They also highlight the welcoming atmosphere, live music events, and the unique attached record store. Guests mention the staff are friendly, helpful, and provide excellent service.

name: Starbucks Coffee Company
address: 3107 S Orange Ave, Orlando, FL 32806, USA
ai_summary: Coffee chain serving up classic espresso drinks as well as Frappuccinos.
review_summary:
Reviewers consistently praise this coffee shop for its delicious coffee and food, noting that orders are prepared perfectly and modifications are accurately followed. Customers also appreciate the friendly and efficient staff and the clean environment.

Some reviews mention the drinks can be incorrectly made.
